question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Around'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Around"** is the most appropriate choice to fill in blank number 1.
 
• The **context here** is the relationship between honey bees (Apis mellifera) and the ecosystem, and** "around us" **suggests the bees' presence and role in the environment that surrounds us.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's analyze the other options:
 
 
• **"Across us"** - The preposition "across" would suggest movement from one side of us to the other, which is not the intended meaning here.
 
• **"Prior to us"** - This would suggest that the bees were part of the ecosystem before us, which doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• **"Within us"** - This would imply that the bees are inside us, which is not the case.
